name: Hazard
description: Hazard boards on concrete: black panels striped with yellow, red or white chevrons that point up, down, left or right from board to board.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1)); -webkit-clip-path: inset(7%); clip-path: inset(7%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); --k: @p(2, 3, 4); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -30%; background: @match($(k - 2) == 0, @p(var(--color2)), $(k - 2) == 1, @p(var(--color3)), @p(var(--color4))); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 11.11%, transparent 11.11% 22.22%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 11.11%, transparent 11.11% 22.22%); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%); -webkit-transform: rotate(45deg); transform: rotate(45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -30%; background: @match($(k - 2) == 0, @p(var(--color2)), $(k - 2) == 1, @p(var(--color3)), @p(var(--color4))); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 11.11%, transparent 11.11% 22.22%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 11.11%, transparent 11.11% 22.22%); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%); clip-path: polygon(100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%); -webkit-transform: rotate(-45deg); transform: rotate(-45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
